assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Primary request: a single futuristic white-and-gray antigravity hoverboard angled from lower left toward upper right, with bright cyan engine jets and a few broad soft-blue speed streaks. NIKKE-inspired anime military science-fiction equipment painting, hand-painted cel shading, crisp dark contours, deliberate broad highlights, rich but controlled colors. The board is the one central subject, fills about 75 percent of the square, and has a bold simple recognizable silhouette. Deep navy background extends to every edge, with darker uncluttered corners. No rider, no humans or faces, no additional objects. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, UI frame, button rim, border, or checkerboard. Opaque image, not transparent. Avoid fine decorative clutter, photorealistic rendering, and miniature components that disappear at icon size.
